picks.what: Simbirsk seen from the northwest road, engraving
picks.why: true view of Simbirsk, named in the engraved caption; churches and kremlin skyline on the Volga heights

gaps: P0–P2: no candidates; P4–P5: no candidates; P6: only hazy airplane-window shots of outlying districts, skipped
notes: Commons dates the engraving only to the second half of the 18th century; the Makhaev attribution (he died in 1770) would narrow it to 1750–70 but is unconfirmed, so the label uses the wider range.
